name: Geodesic Loss Approximation for 2D/3D Registration
definition: An end-to-end deep learning architecture that learns a convex similarity metric for 2D/3D registration by approximating the geodesic gradient in SE(3).
summary: Geodesic Loss Approximation trains a neural network to align its gradient direction with the true geodesic gradient, enabling end-to-end learning of a convex similarity metric that extends the capture range for 2D/3D registration.
